create_Mamba2Metadata_decode: create Mamba2Metadata for decode-only forward pass using prepare_decode with seq_lens and batch info
create_Mamba2Metadata_mixed: create Mamba2Metadata for mixed extend requests with chunked prefill using prepare_mixed and ForwardBatch
compute_chunk_indices_offsets: compute chunk_indices and chunk_offsets from query_start_loc tensor and chunk_size for logical chunking
build_ForwardMetadata: build ForwardMetadata dataclass with query_start_loc tensor and mamba_cache_indices for forward pass
